title: ReviewFinding
description: Structured finding emitted by a reviewer participant during peer review.

id.description: Finding identifier unique within the reviewer's output (e.g. F1, F2)

target.description: Target file path or entity relative to the repository root

issue_key.description: Clustering key for identical issues across reviewers

claim.description: Core assertion explaining the finding in 1-2 sentences

evidence.description: Concrete code lines, tests, or logic proofs supporting the claim
